question: As of July 2022, who among the following was the Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nitin Gadkari.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitin Gadkari** was the Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways.
 
• The main Responsibilities of this ministry are Planning, development and maintenance of National Highways in the country.
